selection_basis: Bounded source-documented omitted-Shapiro ELL1H preparation. Preserve native NHARMS 7, original five free orbital terms, paired DM and published phase cuts. No calibration or planet search.

diagnostics.criterion: Conditional preparation diagnostics, not a noise posterior or signal significance. Retain hold if fixed-noise harmonic adequacy fails at p<0.0027 or a declared noise alternative improves timing-marginalized null objective by more than 10. Boundary optima flag insufficient noise scope. No observed outer-period scan.
